title.narrative: Strengthened adaptation capacity for a green and resilient economy in South Africa

description.narrative: South Africa is particularly affected by climate change hazards such as recurring and extensive heat waves and dry spells, rainfall increase and storm surges. The associated impacts of these extreme weather events have a bearing on economic and social aspects of the country#s development. As the country just embarks on a transition to a low-carbon, climate-resilient and environmentally-sustainable economy, a clear window of opportunity exists to accelerate the shift to a domestic green economy. In order to ease the pressure of climate change-related impacts in South Africa while improving the resilience of its economy, this project aims to reduce South Africa#s vulnerability to climate change effects and promote adaptation solutions on energy, water and mobility with particular emphasis on medium to large enterprises. The project will make these critical services more climate resilient through tailored policy support, technology transfer and enhanced cooperation between governments, private sector and academia in South Africa and Flanders. At the national level, the project will strengthen institutional capacity and enhance awareness of the governmental stakeholders.
